status.description: Whether the lookup resolved or needs more input: resolved, ambiguous, or notFound.

reasonCode.description: A stable reason code: EXACT_MATCH, STRONG_MATCH, MULTIPLE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CANDIDATES, INSUFFICIENT_CONFIDENCE, or NO_CANDIDATES.

value.description: The canonical value to pass as the argument.

selected.description: The selected lookup option, when one exact match exists.

value.description: The canonical value to pass as the argument.

candidates.description: Matching options the caller can choose from.

source.description: Where the choices came from: fixedOptions (the argument's own list) or lookupAction (a provider read).

labelKey.description: The source field shown as the option label.

valueKey.description: The source field passed as the argument value.

actionId.description: The action that lists the options, or null for fixed options.

lookup.description: The lookup definition for this argument.

limit.description: The limit the source was asked for.

offset.description: The offset the source was asked for.

fetchedCandidatesCount.description: How many options the source answered.

paging.description: Offset paging details for the candidates.

code.description: NO_CANDIDATES, or the reasonCode that needs a choice.

hints.description: Instructions for the caller when more input is needed.
